title: Ukraine’s Defense Forces strike over two million enemy targets with drones this year
summary: Since the beginning of 2026, units of Ukraine’s Defense Forces have struck more than two million enemy targets using drones, killing or severely injuring more than 320,000 Russian invaders. The highest number of strikes was recorded in October, at more than 257,000.

title: Russian forces deploy fiber-optic-controlled Molniya drones on various front-line sectors – presidential advisor
summary: Russian forces have been using Molniya drones controlled via fiber-optic cables on various sectors of the front line over the past several days.

title: Swiss REPIC offers grants for renewable energy projects in Ukraine
summary: Innovative projects in renewable energy, energy efficiency and resource efficiency in Ukraine can apply for grants of up to CHF 750,000 under a funding program offered by the Swiss platform REPIC.

title: Ukraine performs first bone-anchored implant surgeries for limb prosthetics in two veterans
summary: Ukrainian and Swedish doctors have performed the first two operations in Ukraine under a pilot project providing free osseointegration prosthetics to veterans.

title: Simferopol residents rush to stock up on food and fuel after attacks on Kerch Bridge – Chubarov
summary: Residents of Simferopol in temporarily occupied Crimea are buying up food and fuel in large quantities following attacks on the Kerch Bridge.

title: NATO fully recognizes new war domains: Cyber and electromagnetic – NSATU Commander
summary: Modern warfare has moved beyond traditional domains. NATO’s Security Assistance and Training for Ukraine (NSATU) mission is therefore integrating electronic warfare and cyber defense training and equipment provision at all levels, from recruits to corps headquarters.

title: General Staff confirms three oil tanks hit at pumping station in Russia’s Tatarstan
summary: On November 19, the Defense Forces of Ukraine struck the Kaleykino oil pumping station near Almetyevsk in Russia’s Republic of Tatarstan, a key hub of the Druzhba oil pipeline. Three large oil storage tanks have been confirmed hit.

title: Russian attack forces nuclear power plants to reduce output - Energy Ministry
summary: Ukraine's nuclear power plants were forced to reduce electricity generation following a large-scale Russian attack overnight and on the morning of November 20. A gradual return to normal operations will be possible once damaged power networks are restored.

title: Ukrainian forces hit three Russian ballistic missile launchers – Zelensky
summary: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky said that the Defense Forces hit three Russian ballistic missile launchers overnight. One was destroyed, while the results of the strikes on the other two are still being assessed.

title: Women account for 60% of new individual entrepreneur registrations in Ukraine this year – Opendatabot
summary: Women registered 148,470 individual entrepreneur entities in Ukraine in January-October 2026, accounting for 60% of all new registrations during the period.

title: Two Russian missiles, jet-powered drone crash in Poland – Defense Minister
summary: Polish Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz said that two Russian missiles and a drone crashed on Polish territory overnight into Friday, November 20, as Moscow launched a massive attack on Ukraine.

title: Russian forces attack Sumy region, injuring woman and sparking massive fire
summary: Russian drones struck residential buildings in the Nova Sloboda community in the Konotop district and the Hlukhiv community in the Shostka district of the Sumy region.

title: Merz, Koretskyi open German-Ukrainian Business Forum in Berlin
summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and Ukrainian Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi opened the ninth German-Ukrainian Business Forum in Berlin on Friday, with discussions focused on investment, strategic industries and Ukraine's reconstruction.

title: Ukraine cooperating with Poland in probe into airspace violation – FM Sybiha
summary: Ukraine is working closely with Poland to assist in investigating the violation of Polish airspace during Russia's massive attack.

title: Illegal fuel depot with UAH 10M worth of counterfeit petrol and diesel uncovered in Kyiv
summary: An illegal fuel depot where A-95 petrol and diesel fuel were produced for sale through filling stations in Kyiv and other regions has been uncovered in the Ukrainian capital. Assets seized during the operation are valued at about UAH 10 million.

title: Russian strikes damage Ukrenergo substations, emergency outages imposed in two regions
summary: Russian attacks have caused significant damage to Ukraine's energy infrastructure, including substations belonging to NPC Ukrenergo. Emergency power outages have been imposed in the Poltava and Kharkiv regions as a result.

title: Poland investigating crash of unidentified object near border during Russian attack on Ukraine
summary: Polish military authorities are investigating two incidents involving possible violations of the country's airspace during Russia's massive attack on Ukraine overnight on November 20.

title: Ukraine’s air defenses down 82 missiles, 380 Russian drones overnight
summary: Ukraine's air defenses neutralized 82 missiles and 380 drones launched by Russian forces in an attack on Ukraine overnight on November 20. Russian strikes were recorded at 23 locations.

title: Government directs additional UAH 81.4 bln to urgent Defense Ministry needs
summary: The Cabinet of Ministers has allocated an additional UAH 81.4 billion for the urgent needs of Ukraine's Ministry of Defense.

title: Death toll from Russian attack on Kyiv rises to six, 15 injured
summary: The death toll from Russia's overnight attack on Kyiv has risen to six.

title: Ukraine approves methodology for identifying strategic and critical mineral resources
summary: Ukraine's Cabinet of Ministers has approved a methodology developed by the Ministry of Economy and Environment for identifying mineral resources of strategic and critical importance.

title: Russia launches up to 100 missiles at Ukraine, one may have crossed into Poland – Ignat
summary: During a combined attack on Ukraine overnight on November 20, Russia launched up to 100 missiles, one of which may have crossed into Polish airspace.

title: Russian forces attack transport and industrial infrastructure in Zhytomyr region, one injured
summary: Russian forces attacked transport and industrial infrastructure in the Korosten district of the Zhytomyr region, injuring one person.

title: U.S. dollar and euro exchange rates on November 20
summary: The U.S. dollar fell by UAH 0.15, while the euro lost UAH 0.04.

title: NATO focuses on building integrated air defense ecosystem for Ukraine – NSATU commander
summary: The NATO Security Assistance and Training for Ukraine (NSATU) mission is focused on building an integrated air defense ecosystem that combines ground-based systems and aviation, rather than relying solely on ballistic missile interceptors.

title: Drones attack chemical plant producing components for explosives in Russia's Smolensk region – media
summary: Drones have attacked the Dorogobuzh chemical plant in Russia's Smolensk region.

title: Russian attack damages railway infrastructure, several trains delayed
summary: Railway infrastructure has been damaged in a Russian attack.

title: Two killed, four injured in Russian attack on railway station in Lviv
summary: Two people were killed and at least four others injured in a Russian attack on Lviv this morning.

title: War update: 278 clashes on front line over past day, Pokrovsk sector hottest
summary: A total of 278 combat engagements between the Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line on November 19, with the highest number recorded in the Pokrovsk sector.

title: Russian forces strike agricultural enterprise in Mykolaiv region
summary: Russian forces attacked an agricultural enterprise in Bereznehuvate, Mykolaiv region, yesterday using Iskander-M ballistic missiles and Shahed-type drones.

title: Russian forces launch over ten attacks on Dnipropetrovsk region, five injured
summary: Russian forces have attacked the Dnipropetrovsk region more than ten times with drones since the evening, injuring five people and damaging civilian facilities.

title: Russia loses another 2,150 troops in war against Ukraine
summary: Russia's total combat losses from February 24, 2022, to November 20, 2026, have reached approximately 1,633,130 personnel, including 2,150 troops killed or wounded over the past day.

title: Three killed, 15 injured in Russian attack on Kyiv
summary: Three people have been killed and 15 injured in a Russian missile attack on Kyiv.

title: Kyiv’s Podilskyi and Darnytskyi bridges damaged in Russian ballistic attack – mayor
summary: The Podilsko-Voskresenskyi and Darnytskyi bridges in Kyiv were damaged in Russian ballistic missile strikes, and a critical infrastructure facility was also hit.

title: Republicans in Congress criticize Trump’s meeting with Xi and Putin
summary: Republicans in the U.S. Congress have warned that agreements reached by Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin to increase energy supplies will strengthen Moscow's position and undermine efforts to counter Russian aggression.

title: Nine people injured in Russian strikes in Kharkiv region on Friday
summary: Nine people were injured in Russian strikes in Kharkiv and the surrounding region on Friday, November 20.

title: Ukraine to build future security architecture with European support – NSATU Commander
summary: Ukraine will lead the process of developing and maintaining its future security architecture, with support from European partners.

title: Russian forces attack Kryvyi Rih, injuring 20 people
summary: Russian forces struck Kryvyi Rih, damaging a restaurant, garages and cars. Twenty people were injured.

title: White House wants Ukraine-Russia peace deal by January, FT reports
summary: The U.S. President Donald Trump administration has told European and Ukrainian officials that it wants a peace deal between Ukraine and Russia to be reached by early January 2027, before Democrats take control of the U.S. Congress.

title: Europe sets up working groups to develop unified position ahead of next round of peace talks – source
summary: European countries will coordinate their positions on peace negotiations concerning Ukraine within the Coalition of the Willing, NATO and the European Council. Meanwhile, specially established working groups involving the United States, Ukraine and European partners will work on documents intended to form the basis for the next round of negotiations.

title: Russia launches massive attack on DTEK TPP, forcing it to halt generation
summary: Russia has launched a massive attack on a DTEK thermal power plant, forcing it to suspend electricity generation.

title: NABU and SAPO facing media attack, Kryvonos says
summary: The National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (NABU) and the Specialized Anti-Corruption Prosecutor’s Office (SAPO) are facing a “media attack” aimed at shifting the focus from corruption investigations to conspiracy theories.

title: Russian attacks cause UAH 6 bln in damage to Kharkiv aircraft plant, Director says
summary: Damage to the Kharkiv State Aircraft Manufacturing Company (KSAMC) caused by Russian shelling has reached UAH 6 billion.

title: Estonia summons Russian chargé d’affaires over attacks on Ukraine
summary: On November 20, Estonia’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs summoned Russia’s chargé d’affaires to protest Russian missile and drone attacks on Ukraine.

title: Moldova reports second drone incursion into its airspace in one day
summary: An unauthorized drone flight into Moldova’s airspace was recorded twice on November 20.

title: France calls for renewed debate on Ukraine's NATO membership – source
summary: France is once again raising the issue of Ukraine's NATO membership amid an acceleration of negotiations to end the war and the need to define long-term security guarantees for Ukraine and Europe.

title: Crimean Bridge attack: Dutch journalist says Russia-24 distorted his words
summary: Russia's state propaganda channel Russia-24 used footage from a broadcast by Dutch radio station BNR, distorting the words of its correspondent, Geert Jan Hahn, in a report about the Crimean Bridge.

title: Trump claims Putin sent drones and ‘little missiles’ into Poland by mistake
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump has claimed that Russian drones and missiles enter Polish territory "by mistake."

title: Injury toll from Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia rises to ten
summary: The number of people injured in Russian attacks in Zaporizhzhia's Kosmichnyi district has risen to ten.

title: EU approves another EUR 1B in military aid for Ukraine
summary: The Council of the European Union has adopted two decisions allowing the provision of EUR 1 billion in additional military assistance to the Ukrainian Armed Forces through joint procurement of lethal and non-lethal equipment under the European Peace Facility (EPF).

title: At least 1,144 children killed or injured in Ukraine in first ten months of 2026 – UNICEF
summary: The number of children killed or injured in Ukraine as a result of the war in 2026 has already exceeded last year's figure and could approach the 2022 level by the end of the year.

title: Russian guided bomb strikes near apartment building in Zaporizhzhia, injuring four
summary: Russian forces attacked Zaporizhzhia with guided aerial bombs. One of the bombs landed near an apartment building, injuring four people.

title: EU and UK pledge continued joint support for Ukraine
summary: The European Union and the United Kingdom have pledged to continue supporting Ukraine in its fight against Russian aggression and to maintain pressure on Russia to achieve a just and lasting peace.

title: Ukraine seeks to deepen rail modernization cooperation with Deutsche Bahn – Koretskyi
summary: Ukraine is seeking to deepen its strategic partnership with Germany's Deutsche Bahn, particularly in the development of standard-gauge rail lines, infrastructure modernization, and upgrades to locomotives, rolling stock and railway stations.

title: Merz identifies obstacles to deeper defense cooperation with Ukraine
summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has called for better conditions for joint defense production with Ukraine, identifying export duties and legal restrictions on transferring intellectual property rights as obstacles to the development of joint technologies.

title: Merz names two conditions for continued financial support for Ukraine
summary: Continued reforms in the areas of the rule of law and the fight against corruption are prerequisites for further financial assistance to Ukraine, attracting investment and maintaining long-term support from Germany.

title: Ukraine plans to launch EUR 3B war risk insurance fund in January – Koretskyi
summary: Ukraine plans to launch a war risk insurance fund capitalized at EUR 3 billion with international partners in January 2027 to protect investments against war-related risks.

title: Ukrainian forces hit Russian air defense system in Bryansk region, drone command post in Donetsk region
summary: On November 19 and overnight into November 20, Ukraine's Defense Forces struck a number of Russian military facilities inside Russia and in the Donetsk, Luhansk and Zaporizhzhia regions.

title: Death toll from Russian attack on Kyiv rises to seven, 17 injured
summary: The death toll from Russia's attack on Kyiv has risen to seven, with 17 people injured.

title: EU disburses EUR 7.9 bln to strengthen Ukraine’s financial stability
summary: On November 20, the European Commission disbursed €7.9 billion to Ukraine to support the country’s financial needs and the functioning of its public administration. This is the largest single disbursement under the Ukraine Facility.

title: Russian forces maneuver under cover of fog in Huliaipole sector – Air Assault Forces
summary: In the Huliaipole sector, Russian invading forces are carrying out maneuvers using cars and motorcycles under cover of fog.
